name: The Carousel of Singing Shells
description: A seaside carousel where each mount is a different sea creature made of polished shells, and as it turns, the shells sing harmonies inspired by ocean waves, with pearl-like lights reflecting off the water.
prompt: Seaside carousel with sea creature mounts made of polished shells, shells emitting musical tones as carousel turns, harmonies inspired by ocean waves, pearl-like lights reflecting on water, detailed shell textures, coastal setting, golden hour lighting, magical marine atmosphere
caption: Let the ocean's song carry you away on waves of wonder. Every shell has a story to share. 🐚🎶
